verdict.rationale: Helicone's documented analytics are dashboards, HQL queries, alerts, and request logs. None of the evidence describes the product generating AI insights or suggestions from a user's data inside the product. The webhook-based 'real-time evaluation' is a workflow the user builds on outbound notifications, a developer building block that does not count as an in-product AI insights feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
